understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each KA59 level by getting every selectable piece onto the goal tile(s) marked with a '+', with all goals occupied simultaneously to trigger WIN and advance until the final level is cleared.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: A piece could be controlled by selecting it (via CLICK) and then moving it by clicking target tiles; the piece only changed position when the destination was reachable/valid, otherwise it stayed put (blocked). Obstacles/walls prevented movement into or through certain cells, so clicks on blocked or non-reachable positions had no effect; solving required positioning multiple pieces without overlaps and respecting these collision/blocking rules.
